lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-intensity circular pixel clusters arranged in an irregular, staggered formation across the visible lower-left quadrant of the frame.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical and horizontal bands of elevated pixel intensity forming a coarse grid pattern, with high-luminance blobs positioned within the grid cells.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A pronounced linear ridge running horizontally along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with highlights on the superior edge and shadowing on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A sparse distribution of diffuse, low-contrast high-luminance blobs concentrated primarily in the lower and posterior sections of the dorsal fin's silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A visible notch or irregular indentation is present on the lower posterior trailing edge of the dorsal fin.
